requirement:
修复票价计算和座位分配相关的 bug。
票价服务的数据传递存在异常，导致座位分配时价格计算不准确。
需要检查票价服务与座位、订票服务之间的数据流。

details.name: ts-price-service
details.rationale: Price calculation is central to the bug; seat service likely calls price service for fare data.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order service handles booking and may pass price/seat data, interacting with both seat and price services.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: Preserve service orchestrates ticket booking and likely invokes seat and price services, so data flow changes affect it.

details.name: ts-travel-service
details.rationale: Travel service may provide trip details used in price calculation and seat allocation, potentially affected by data flow changes.

details.name: ts-travel2-service
details.rationale: Similar to travel service, may be involved in route/trip data that influences pricing and seat availability.

details.name: ts-route-service
details.rationale: Route service supplies route information that could affect price calculation, though less directly tied to seat allocation.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Handles other order types that might also use seat and price services, but lower likelihood of direct impact.
